Growing by 3 has to close the bore, because the wall grows 3 from every side while the bore is only 2 wide, so the cavity becomes a real one and the result must be a hollow ball again. Shrinking by 3 is the counter-test: the wall thins from 8 to 2 and the bore widens, so the body stays a single open surface.
